write_scope_resolution.interpretation: An exact frozen command provider is an implicit executable deliverable when the same task contract requires that exact path, despite omission from the prose allowlist.

cumulative_actual_write_provenance.source_links: every recursively explicit receipt.inputs entry whose verified JSON payload is a receipt, manifest, closure, independent validation, preservation map, or standalone evidence container with actor provenance
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.standalone_evidence_traversal: top-level provenance, producer_provenance, named *_provenance, and registered direct reviewer/signer identity fields
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.conservative_unclassified_rule: every historical actor enters all/evidence/historical_task and any actor without a typed category also enters unclassified; unclassified actors remain in T22/T24 prior universes
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.derivation: current task producer set derives only from current receipt outputs; historical sets retain the union of every actor fact from every recursively explicit prior container and are never reset to current producers
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.normal_acceptance_rule: acceptance actor is disjoint from current task producer set
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.machine_delivery_statement_assignment_ru: exactly one stable royzuo-codex_session-delivery_statement row; actor_type codex_session; roles exactly [machine_delivery_statement]; T23 assigned; every other actor is codex_session
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.machine_delivery_statement_rule: phase4_machine_delivery_statement_acknowledgement enters acknowledgement_only but not all/evidence/historical_task/unclassified/delivery_statement production sets and is not T23 approval
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.t23_rule: current machine-only signer may produce only the current T23 codex_session signature; signer must be disjoint from complete T00-T22 all/evidence/unclassified/product/controller/operator/oracle/development/power/formal/e2e_readiness/manifest/replay/validator/reviewer/delivery_statement sets
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.t22_rule: current T22 reviewer may produce T22 review output but must be disjoint from complete T00-T21 historical all set and controller/operator/validator roles
cumulative_actual_write_provenance.t24_rule: current T24 approver may directly produce T24 verdict and self-accept it but must be disjoint from complete T00-T23 historical all set and controller/operator/validator/reviewer/delivery_statement roles
